data.description_en:
BIOCURCUMIN+ ✨
Curcumin + Piperine Blend

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION

This is not regular turmeric powder.

BioCurcumin+ is a concentrated blend of high-purity curcumin extract paired with piperine from black pepper — designed for absorption, not decoration.

Whole turmeric root contains only a small percentage of curcumin. Most of it passes through the body with limited uptake.

We don’t play that game.

This formula uses standardized extracts and a precise ratio, so what you consume actually matters.

WHY PEOPLE CONSUME IT

Curcumin concentration — curcumin is the primary active compound found in turmeric, commonly consumed to support normal inflammatory balance.
Absorption support — piperine is widely used to improve curcumin bioavailability.
Joint & mobility support — often chosen by people with physically active lifestyles.
Antioxidant support — helps protect cells from oxidative stress as part of a balanced diet.
Daily resilience — commonly included in long-term wellness routines.

INGREDIENTS

Turmeric Extract (from turmeric root, standardized to 95% curcumin)
Black Pepper Extract (standardized to 98% piperine)

CERTIFICATION NOTE

Made with ingredients certified USDA Organic and verified Non-GMO.

HOW TO USE

Serving size: 500–1000mg per day

500mg — daily maintenance
1000mg — increased support when needed

Mix into smoothies, golden lattes, plant milk, soups, or food.

For better absorption, consume with a source of healthy fat.
data.description_cn:
BioCurcumin+ ✨
姜黄素 + 胡椒碱复合配方

产品介绍

这不是普通姜黄粉。

本产品采用姜黄根提取物，并进行标准化处理，以提高姜黄素含量。

同时搭配黑胡椒提取物中的胡椒碱，形成复合植物原料组合。

相较于整根姜黄粉，该配方成分更集中、组成更明确。

原料简单，配比清晰。

为什么有人选择它

姜黄素是姜黄中的主要成分之一。
胡椒碱常作为植物提取物配伍原料使用。
复合配方形式适合注重原料结构与成分明确性的人群。
常用于日常饮食补充中。 🌱

配料

姜黄提取物（来自姜黄根，标准化为95%姜黄素）
黑胡椒提取物（标准化为98%胡椒碱）

认证说明

原料通过 USDA Organic 认证，非转基因（Non-GMO）。

食用方式

建议食用量：每日500–1000毫克

可加入饮品、植物奶、汤品或其他食物中食用。

建议与含脂肪类食物一同食用。

本产品通过美国 USDA 有机认证（USDA Organic）。

data.description_en:
SPIRULINA POWDER 💚

USDA Organic · Non-GMO
Net weight: 130g
Origin: China 🌍

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION

This is spirulina powder.

Made from dried spirulina, a naturally occurring microalgae, gently processed and finely ground.

Spirulina has long been consumed as a food ingredient, valued for its concentrated plant protein and naturally occurring micronutrients.

We keep it simple — whole ingredient, minimal processing, nothing added.

An easy way to add a nutrient-dense plant ingredient to everyday meals.

WHY PEOPLE CONSUME IT

Plant protein — contributes to the maintenance of muscle mass and normal body tissues.
Iron — contributes to normal oxygen transport and energy metabolism.
Vitamin B12 (analogues) — involved in normal energy metabolism and nervous system function.
Iodine — contributes to normal thyroid function and energy metabolism.
Chlorophyll & phycocyanin — naturally occurring pigments commonly associated with antioxidant activity.

INGREDIENTS

Spirulina Powder 💚

CONTAINS / MAY CONTAIN

Contains: None
May contain traces of: Nuts, Soy, Gluten

HOW TO USE

Serving size: 2–3g (about 1 teaspoon)
How often: Once per day

Mix into water, smoothies, juices, or food.

Start small and adjust based on taste and routine.

STORAGE & SHELF LIFE

Storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight ❄️
Shelf life: See packaging
After opening: Keep sealed and use regularly

NUTRITION FACTS (PER 100G)

Energy 1450kJ (17%)
Protein 60g (100%)
Fat 7.5g (13%)
Carbohydrate 23g (8%)
Sodium 1000mg (50%)
Iron 28mg (156%)
Iodine 180µg (120%)
Vitamin B12 5.0µg (208%)

NET CONTENT & PACKAGING

Net weight: 130g
Packaging: Reusable aluminum container

INTENDED USE / NOTES

For general consumption
Suitable for plant-based diets 🌿
Not suitable for individuals allergic to algae

Vitamin and mineral values are based on generic food composition data for spirulina and are provided for reference only.
data.description_cn:
螺旋藻粉 💚

净含量：130g
原料产地：中国 🌍

产品介绍

这是螺旋藻粉。

选用螺旋藻，经干燥处理并研磨成细粉。

螺旋藻作为一种藻类原料，长期被用于日常饮食中，其营养来源于藻体本身。

生产过程中不进行提取、不做营养强化，也不添加其他成分，保持原料原有形态。

适合希望在日常饮食中增加植物性原料摄入的人群。

为什么有人选择它

螺旋藻属于营养密度较高的藻类植物原料。
其植物营养结构参与人体基础生理活动，是日常饮食结构中的自然组成部分。
以完整原料形式摄入，成分清晰，加工克制。
适合偏好真实食材、少加工、长期可持续饮食方式的人群。 🌱

配料

螺旋藻粉 💚

致敏原信息

本产品不含已知致敏原
生产环境可能接触：坚果、大豆、含麸质谷物

食用方式

建议食用量：2–3克（约1茶匙）
食用频率：每日1次

可加入水、饮品、汤品或食物中食用。

建议从少量开始，根据个人饮食习惯调整。

储存方式与保质期

储存方式：置于阴凉、干燥处，避免阳光直射 ❄️
保质期：见包装标示
开封后请密封保存，并尽快食用

营养成分表（每100克）

能量 1450kJ (17%)
蛋白质 60g (100%)
脂肪 7.5g (13%)
碳水化合物 23g (8%)
钠 1000mg (50%)

规格与包装

净含量：130g
包装形式：可重复使用铝制容器

补充说明

认证说明：原料通过 USDA Organic 认证，非转基因（Non-GMO）

食用提示

适合日常人群食用
适合植物性饮食人群 🌿
对藻类过敏者不适合食用

本产品通过美国 USDA 有机认证（USDA Organic）。
